heading: Out of the spreadsheet.
summary: Most teams run on one shared spreadsheet until it breaks. We turn it into an admin system built around how your team already works.
lead: Most teams run on one shared spreadsheet until it breaks: four copies, the same client twice, a total nobody trusts. We turn it into an admin system built around how your team already works.
leadAction: Scroll, and watch the file sort itself out.
leadActionStill: Pick a step to see each part, starting with the file it replaces.

sheet.text: Where most businesses start. It works, until two people edit it at once.

pipeline.text: Every deal on one board. Move one to the next stage and the totals follow.

roles.text: The owner sees everything, sales sees their own deals, support sees only what it needs.

automations.text: A new lead alerts the right manager in seconds and becomes a task. Nobody copies anything by hand.

reports.text: Live numbers from the same data, instead of a spreadsheet someone rebuilds every Friday.

integrations.text: Accounting, payments, messengers and email, connected so the data moves by itself.
